A flat valley bar above a continuous party-wall cap is a dam; a sloped channel also needs lowered wall caps and open end-wall scuppers.
The first support view cropped its actual framing; the revised camera frames the evaluated support meshes and hides unrelated weather pieces.
The ceiling clearance and rendered slab underside disagreed by 0.15 m. House record spreading also overwrote floor/ceiling IDs.
Strong fixture point lights overexposed the interior wall.
